# Ifan Jaya Suswanto Zalukhu

> Senior C# .NET Backend Engineer, Head of Engineering at SimpliDOTS, and AWS Community Builder (AI Engineering). Based in Indonesia, working fully remote for ~6 years.

Ifan designs and ships scalable backend systems — high-performance APIs, microservices architectures across SaaS and supply chain domains. He combines engineering leadership with hands-on coding, and actively contributes to the developer community through speaking engagements, workshops, and open-source.

Key areas of expertise: C# / .NET Core, AWS (ECS, Lambda, SQS), Azure, AI/LLM integration, n8n workflow automation, Docker, and engineering team leadership.
